title: Mini-variant tally — Amira Khan
body:
Quick personal tracker for tiny variant runs — lightweight table I update during local debug sessions.

Context: trying small quantization and batching changes for 2.7B and 7B variants to hit <50ms median latency at batch=1 while keeping cost <0.5x baseline.

Columns: date | run_id | model | quant | batch | seq | avg_ms | p95_ms | tokens | cost_per_1k | notes

2024-11-15 | amr-001 | rw-2.7B | int8-e | 1 | 128 | 48 | 112 | 1,024 | $0.42 | noisy tails; tried kernelA
2024-11-16 | amr-002 | rw-2.7B | fp16 | 1 | 128 | 62 | 140 | 1,024 | $0.58 | baseline for comparison
2024-11-20 | amr-009 | rw-7B | int8-e | 1 | 128 | 92 | 180 | 1,024 | $1.10 | good perf, but higher p95 on long prompts
2024-11-27 | amr-014 | rw-2.7B | int4+ | 1 | 64 | 35 | 75 | 512 | $0.30 | promising; quant artifacts in generation for names
2024-11-30 | amr-017 | rw-2.7B | int4+ | 2 | 64 | 46 | 88 | 1,024 | $0.28 | batch=2 improves cost, slight p95 hit

Notes / quick thoughts:
- int4+ seems best cost/latency, but need eval set for quality regressions (prompt hallucination on numeric tables).
- kernelA reduces avg but increases p95; likely less stable under KV cache pressure.
- TODO: add small eval harness (10 prompts) to flag regressions; link to INF-1342.
- TODO: test warm vs cold latency with 30s idle to replicate real traffic.
- Quick checklist when running a variant:
  * record run_id and seed
  * save perf traces (trace_*.json)
  * snapshot model config and kernel flags

Unresolved:
- whether to prioritize batch=1 p50 or aggregated cost per 1k tokens for product use-case.
- need a small automated alert when p95 crosses 150ms for 2.7B

Local file refs:
- /home/amira/runs/amr-014/trace.log
- /home/amira/evals/smoke/quick-10.json

Last updated notes: planning to spin a canary with int4+ + kernelB next week; check with infra for microburst behavior.
